====Declension====
{{pl-decl-noun-irreg}}
* The {{w|Central Greater Poland dialect}} ({{w|Kalisz}}) and {{w|Western Kraków dialect}} show the nominative plural form {{m|pl|dziecka}}.
* The {{w|Kielce dialect}} ({{w|Opatów County}}) shows the dative plural form {{m|pl|dzieckom}}.
* The {{w|Western Kraków dialect}} ({{w|Sławków}}) shows the instrumental plural form {{m|pl|dzieckami}}.
